scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @golive/core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @golive/core && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w @golive/mobile
